findings.friction_name: order confirmation number is hard to find

evidence.captured_text: Order tracking number 1234567890123456 confirmed; reference id 5551234.

findings.narrative: A 16-digit order/tracking number (1234567890123456) that is NOT Luhn-valid (verified false), plus a short 7-digit reference id. The card-number pattern requires a 13-19 digit Luhn-VALID sequence, so neither must be redacted — the card-number class's survive negative control, closing its missing survive fixture (F43/F44/F153, CR9 class-closure audit); an over-broad any-13-19-digit redaction would corrupt this ordinary order copy.
